defs.def: drops of liquid that appear on the surface of your skin when you are hot, ill/sick or afraid 汗

ex.s: But now they are out of breath and sweating.
ex.t: 但现在他们上气不接下气，满头大汗。

ex.s: I woke up sweating and nervous, but ready to prove something to myself.
ex.t: 我醒来时满身是汗、十分紧张，但已准备好向自己证明些什么。

ex.s: I’ve had enough!” “We’re losers, Mr White, not winners,” another young man continued, his face wet with tears and sweat.
ex.t: 我受够了! “我们是失败者，怀特先生，不是胜利者。 ”另一位年轻人继续说，他的脸被眼泪和汗水淋湿。

ex.s: It is the first fall we have had here this winter, and last year I was out of the country, sweating in a hot climate, during the snowy season, so that it really does seem an age since saw the ground so fantastically carpeted.
ex.t: 这是我们今年冬天这里下的第一场雪，去年冬天我出国了，在炎热的气候里汗流浃背，错过了下雪的季节，所以看起来真的好像很多年没有见过大地铺满如此美妙的雪毯了。

ex.s: She couldn’t, however, hide the line of sweat running down her forehead, which was caused partly by the heat of the television studio, but more by fear of the four people seated in front of her.
ex.t: 然而，她无法隐藏从额头流下的汗水——这汗水一部分来自电视演播室的热度，但更多来自对坐在她面前的四个人的恐惧。

ex.s: We could also say However, she couldn’t hide the line of sweat that was dripping down her forehead.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：然而，她无法隐藏从额头滴落的汗水。

defs.def: the state of being covered with sweat 出汗；流汗；一身汗

ex.s: She was sweating partly because of the heat of the television studio, but mostly because of her fear of the four people seated in front of her.
ex.t: 她出汗的部分原因是电视工作室的热量，但主要是因为她害怕坐在她前面的四人。

defs.def: hard work or effort 繁重的工作；艰苦的劳动；累活儿；艰苦努力
a sweatsuit or sweatpants 运动服；运动裤
when you sweat, drops of liquid appear on the surface of your skin, for example when you are hot, ill/sick or afraid 出汗；流汗
if sth sweats, the liquid that is contained in it appears on its surface （物体表面）渗出水分，结水珠
to work hard at sth 艰苦努力；辛苦地干
to worry or feel anxious about sth 担心；焦虑；不安
if you sweat meat or vegetables or let them sweat, you heat them slowly with a little fat in a pan that is covered with a lid 焖
